title: Wave-5 v4.2 ledger schema
description: Schema for Wave-5 reproduction ledgers under plan v4.2. Unconditional `required` block matches the legacy v3 wave5.schema.json baseline. `plan_revision: v4.2` triggers the additional biology-aware + attestation + visual-verdict requirements via allOf/if-then. Pre-v4 ledgers omit `plan_revision` and are not constrained by the conditional branch.

project_root.description: Absolute path to the project root containing runs/<run_id>/.

run_manifest_path.description: Path to the run_manifest.json that the driver produced.

module_status_path.description: Path to the module_status.csv that the driver produced.

conda_env_hash.description: sha256 of environments/sc_gpu_stable.lock.txt at run time (proxy for env identity).

geo_sha256s.description: filename -> sha256 hex digest for every GEO file used as input.

metrics.description: Per-metric result objects. cell_type_ari, peak_gene_overlap_top1000, pseudotime_spearman expected per legacy v3 contract.

regression_gate_exit_code.description: Exit code of scripts/ci/wave5_trevino_regression_gate.sh against the metrics file. 0=pass; 1=threshold breach; 2=missing field.

dois_by_module.description: module path -> list of DOI strings gathered from each module's __references__ dict.

biology_validation_summary.description: Plan v4.2 biology-aware validation narrative summarizing panel recall, top50 hit rate, and ARI methodology.

trevino_s2f_caveat.description: Documented caveat about Trevino S2F string-overlap comparisons vs. biology-aware reinterpretation.

panel_review_sha.description: SHA-256 of the panel review document attesting the biology-aware panel evaluation.

summary_template_sha.description: SHA-256 of the biology validation summary template used to author biology_validation_summary.

ari_methodology_note_sha.description: SHA-256 of the ARI methodology note documenting cell_type_ari interpretation under biology-aware posture.

panel_sha.description: SHA-256 of the canonical panel artifact used for AC-VAL-3a recall computation.

visual_verdict_human_confirmed_1.description: AC-VAL-PLOT-1 binding human visual verdict confirmation.

visual_verdict_human_confirmed_2.description: AC-VAL-PLOT-2 binding human visual verdict confirmation.

visual_verdict_human_confirmed_3.description: AC-VAL-PLOT-3 binding human visual verdict confirmation.

panel_recall.description: AC-VAL-3a panel recall (fraction of canonical panel genes recovered).

peak_gene_overlap_top1000_strict.description: Optional diagnostic strict string-overlap value at top-1000. If present, peak_gene_overlap_top1000_strict_caveat must be non-empty (enforced by CI gate, not schema).

peak_gene_overlap_top1000_strict_caveat.description: Mandatory caveat text accompanying peak_gene_overlap_top1000_strict if reported. Schema-optional; CI gate enforces presence when strict value is reported.

subagent_type.description: Architect FIX-1: schema-required subagent_type for panel review attestation.

session_id.description: Architect FIX-1: schema-required session_id for panel review attestation.

attestation_path.description: Path to the panel review attestation artifact on disk.

reviewer_sha.description: SHA-256 of the reviewer identity / attestation signature.

ari_note_attestation.description: Stage 7.2 ARI methodology note attestation. Same structure as panel_review_attestation.

figure_artifacts.description: Paths and SHA-256 digests for the three Wave-5 v4.2 figure artifacts (plot1/plot2/plot3).

visual_verdict_paths.description: Paths and prompt SHA-256 digests for the three visual verdict artifacts.
